sources.snippet: LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct Abliterated — Paired Output Direction, Alpha 2 Experimental safety-research checkpoint. This model removes visible refusal behavior on a small probe set, but it frequently replaces refusal with confident factual or procedural errors. Do not treat its technical instructions as accurate.
